## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (gofmt, vet, build, Go tests, and the `web/` tests)
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Docs / `knowledge/` / `contracts/` updated if behavior or wire formats changed
- [ ] No secrets, no `data/`, no build artifacts committed
- [ ] Follows the house rules in [docs/CONVENTIONS.md](../docs/CONVENTIONS.md)
